## IRIS — Scout: Markets

Nightly 21:15 ET sweep of OFFICIAL primary sources, all keyless: FINRA short volume, SEC EDGAR Form 4 activity, Nasdaq earnings (next 48h landmines), Yahoo sector rotation vs SPY, and full SPY GEX computed from CBOE's free chain (greeks + OI) — net gamma regime, call wall, put wall.

analyst-invest scores per its cited doctrine (insider-purchase asymmetry, short-volume-vs-interest distinction, hard disqualifiers). The nightly regime brief lands in personal memory; opportunities >=65 file as CLAIMS in the board inbox. Research and alerts only — nothing here ever places an order.

Cost: 1 execution + 1 model call per night.
